answer: Spectral graph-cut gates entry: each new identity routes through a cut separating trusted core from noisy fringe, paying one bond plus a fee per missed probe. A farm spawning N clones pays N times the base bond; each probe is an independent on-chain event. No bulk discount: every cut is answered live by a distinct identity, so N fakes pay N times the base bond. Detected clusters forfeit bonded identity, lose vouching rights for 20 epochs, and are quarantined. Like a canyon where the delta between faking and influence stays open, one violet probe cannot cut the terrace alone.
